sesudah.sql_query:
SELECT
  IFNULL(IFNULL((SELECT pu.tanggal_putusan FROM perkara_putusan pu WHERE pu.perkara_id = #perkara_id# AND pu.tanggal_putusan > '1900-01-01' ORDER BY pu.tanggal_putusan DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT c.rencana_tanggal FROM perkara_court_calendar c WHERE c.perkara_id = #perkara_id# AND c.rencana_tanggal > '1900-01-01' AND (c.rencana_agenda LIKE '%musyawarah%' OR c.rencana_agenda LIKE '%putusan%' OR c.rencana_agenda LIKE '%penetapan%') ORDER BY c.rencana_tanggal DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT 1)), '') AS data

lama.sql_query:
SELECT
  rencana_tanggal AS data
FROM 
  perkara_court_calendar
WHERE 
  perkara_id = #perkara_id#
  AND (
    rencana_agenda LIKE '%musyawarah%'
    OR rencana_agenda LIKE '%putusan%'
    OR rencana_agenda LIKE '%penetapan%'
  )

UNION ALL

SELECT '' AS data
FROM DUAL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM perkara_court_calendar
  WHERE 
    perkara_id = #perkara_id#
    AND (
      rencana_agenda LIKE '%musyawarah%'
      OR rencana_agenda LIKE '%putusan%'
      OR rencana_agenda LIKE '%penetapan%'
    )
);

sesudah.sql_query:
SELECT
  IFNULL(CASE DAYOFWEEK(DATE(x.d))
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Minggu'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Senin'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Selasa'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Rabu'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Kamis'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Jumat'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Sabtu'
  END, '') AS data
FROM (SELECT IFNULL((SELECT pu.tanggal_putusan FROM perkara_putusan pu WHERE pu.perkara_id = #perkara_id# AND pu.tanggal_putusan > '1900-01-01' ORDER BY pu.tanggal_putusan DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT c.rencana_tanggal FROM perkara_court_calendar c WHERE c.perkara_id = #perkara_id# AND c.rencana_tanggal > '1900-01-01' AND (c.rencana_agenda LIKE '%musyawarah%' OR c.rencana_agenda LIKE '%putusan%' OR c.rencana_agenda LIKE '%penetapan%') ORDER BY c.rencana_tanggal DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT 1)) AS d) x

lama.sql_query:
SELECT
  CASE DAYOFWEEK(DATE(rencana_tanggal))
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Minggu'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Senin'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Selasa'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Rabu'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Kamis'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Jumat'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Sabtu'
  END AS data
FROM 
  perkara_court_calendar
WHERE 
  perkara_id = #perkara_id#
  AND (
    rencana_agenda LIKE '%musyawarah%'
    OR rencana_agenda LIKE '%putusan%'
    OR rencana_agenda LIKE '%penetapan%'
  )

UNION ALL

SELECT '' AS data
FROM DUAL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM perkara_court_calendar
  WHERE 
    perkara_id = #perkara_id#
    AND (
      rencana_agenda LIKE '%musyawarah%'
      OR rencana_agenda LIKE '%putusan%'
      OR rencana_agenda LIKE '%penetapan%'
    )
);
